s.note: Léon's French roots, simple and exact
s.how: Warm 2 baguettes at 200C for 6 minutes until the crust crackles. Tear into chunks rather than slicing. Serve with 250g cultured butter left out of the fridge for an hour to soften, and a little dish of flaky salt for sprinkling.

s.note: the plain lunch of a man who owns one plant and one chair
s.how: Warm 300g mixed olives gently in 3 tbsp olive oil with a few strips of orange peel, thyme sprigs and a crushed garlic clove for 5 minutes. Tip into a bowl and serve with cornichons and pickled onions in little dishes.

m.note: the restaurant back room where the jobs are handed out
m.how: Gently cook 4 sliced garlic cloves in 4 tbsp olive oil. Add 2 tins San Marzano tomatoes crushed by hand and simmer 25 minutes. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss through the sauce with basil and 30g butter, and finish with grated parmesan.

w.note: his plant, which always gets the window
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whisk in 3 yolks, then fold in 300ml whipped cream and 3 whites whipped to soft peaks. Layer in four small cups with 150g crushed chocolate biscuits as soil. Chill 3 hours and plant a mint sprig in each.

d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk in the coldest part of the fridge and put four tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour the milk to the brim. Stir a spoon of honey into any glass for anyone who wants it sweet.
